CustomField.description: The registration SKUs whose unpaid order raises "Exam Unpaid" on the alert bar, as a JSON array: ["FRM1E", "FRM2E", "FRM1S", "FRM2S"]. These change every exam season and are the value most likely to be edited by somebody who is not a developer — updating them here is a record edit, no deploy. A populated value REPLACES the service's hard-coded list wholesale (unlike most catalogue reads, which add): a season's SKU list is swapped, not extended, and last season's codes staying alive would raise "Exam Unpaid" against orders that are not exam orders. Leave blank to use GARP_Portal_AlertBarService's hard-coded fallback. Parsed independently of Config__c: a broken value degrades only this alert, with a named warning on the response.
CustomField.label: Alert Product Codes
